parts:
Hi all,

I'm starting up my training workshop program again, and the first workshop is this Thursday, Oct 6th.

UNIX shell:

This half day workshop will provide an introduction to the bash shell.
The shell is a very powerful tool for using scientific software and
working with large data sets. It is primarily used to manage files
and run programs, and it allows for automation of repetitive tasks.

For more information, to view the materials, and to register, please visit:

https://dib-training.readthedocs.io/en/pub/2016-10-06-shell-halfday.html

This workshop will be on main campus in 1043 Valley Hall.

best,
—titus
